title: Chapter 6613: As If I Need Two?

Chapter 6613: As If I Need Two?

Chapter 6613: As If I Need Two?

“What happens if I reach perfect mastery?” Visceraless paused briefly before asking.

“Just like its name, but get to twenty percent first before asking.” Li Qiye said.

“High heaven suppression...” He murmured.

Everyone froze while staring at the gauntlet. Although they didn’t fully believe it, its power was rather convincing.

“You all want this Time Stopper?” Li Qiye waved the treasure at them with a smile.

They regained their wits and exchanged glances, not daring to be reckless.

“It is yours, Young Noble. Only you are qualified to keep it.” Jiu Ning bowed and said.

“If any idiot dares to say no, I’ll be the first to beat them up.” Visceraless offered his service.

Dugu Yuan, Grand Preceptor, and Godstallion exchanged glances. Should they give up now?

“Hold it, I am flexible. I’m not interested in this Time Stopper so it’s fine if someone else wants it.” Li Qiye said, surprising everyone.

“A true man fears nothing, I want this Time Stopper.” Godstallion spoke first.

“Very courageous, you want to seize it?” Li Qiye smiled.

“...” Godstallion had no confidence against the mysterious man.

“Sir, all covet this great treasure. Please excuse us.” Dugu Yuan stated his unwillingness to give up.

“Yes, I would like to see your incredible arts.” Godstallion wanted to try no matter what since he was already here.

“Worthy of being a general under Dingtian.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Sir, if I can last several moves against you, would you give up Time Stopper?” Godstallion wanted to play it safe given Jiu Ning’s respectful attitude. However, he couldn’t possibly be on Dingtian’s level.

“Several? Just survive one and it is yours.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What?!” No one could believe their ears.

“O-one? That’s ridiculous.” A desolate god blurted.

“Even a supreme overlord can’t beat Dingtian’s general in one move.” An emperor whispered.

“I agree.” A primal ancestor said, doubting this ordinary youth’s ability to take down Godstallion in one move.

Grand Preceptor and Dugu Yuan took a deep breath upon hearing this. Killing Godstallion in one move meant being able to kill them in one move as well.

“One move, Sir?” Godstallion’s eyes widened in disbelief.

“As if I need two?” Li Qiye said nonchalantly.

Godstallion didn’t expect the response and turned red. Was this an insult or just the truth spoken by a supreme existence?

“Hahaha.” He laughed and said: “I’ve never met anyone like you outside of my master. Very well, one move it is. If I lose, I forfeit my life.”

His battle spirit only surged after meeting a more powerful foe.

“Start.” Li Qiye waved his hand dismissively.

The crowd attributed his nonchalant demeanor to absolute power. Was he an overlord or an immortal? Either way, they had never seen or heard of him before. Could he kill Godstallion with one move?

“Clank!” He summoned a gigantic sword while still mounted, emanating sword energies like the storms.

They combined into an ocean drowning the battlefield, forcing spectators back. It was mainly golden with a bone spine, blinding everyone with its white rays.

“This blade is Heavenly Dwarf, crafted from a star by my master.” He unsheathed it with both hands.

Everyone felt its immense weight immediately. Emperors thought that he didn’t need to swing to crush them. Just its weight alone was enough.
